book.name: Iba
book.title: Iba ngwi a kye tso iJɔn

content: Ngwi ungwɔnɛ wa nyɛ nɛ ani di ongyesɔ oka kyɛ esho le ba esɛ. O dzɛ yi mfye okwulewo, man okwɔkwɔ mgban nu ɛsɛ gbosa.
O feela mi ela okwukwo gbɛɛ:

content.text: O yɛɛ udɛ emɛsɛ bɛyi imbe mgbi ali onodzi ibwubwe
bɛyi imbe mgbi ingwunɔ ama ntsiidza di kyilitukwu.
Utɔ emi ɛsɛ nɛ kyɔ amah biyan,
man ama okyummya mi ɛsɛ nɛ yɛɛ emi
aludu mi ikye imina mgban obube nani.>>

content: Nɛta ani fwo ela oka kyɛ esho gbɛɛ:

content.text: ikye ni ema ka waabɔ mi ali ibwubwe mgban na ba,
adzi ni ema ka wo isɔ nka ba
Imgbasho di wɛ ungwɔ ibwubwe mgban.
Nun dafi o teyi nu abu mani;
kpan mkpa dudɔ mi ungwɔ ngwi
Ikyesinɛ mi itukwu mgban o tsaabɔ igɛgɛ gbɛɛ,
ani dika kye abɔ tiko kpaa ba.>
ikwongye yi abɔ otiko yi ootse yi owulewo
bɛyi onenbwa omba enbwa ka ba mbon mi egbe onyi.
lubana Otsɛ Imgbasho ogbɔn ikwɔ ma datu.

content: Onɔ ngwi utɔ emi ɛsɛ nɛ ama nkyɔ amah biyan di kyɔ oyabɔ mi omyɛɛ-myɛɛ mgban di iwu mgbi ola ogyeegye mgban yɔ, a ka tsukwu di kye abɔ tiko ikyon.
Isɔ mgban ka wo ma imio, man a ka kwudzɛ fyata le gbɛɛ:

content.text: Mi obyi onyi ta Imgbasho fwo abu ikwɔ waana!>

content: Ama okyummya mi ɛsɛ nɛ ka tsukwu di kyelela ikyon, ikyekyɛ inggisɛ onyi le gya ma okye wuba

okye abashi yi iyudza onzundzɛ okwɔkwɔ yi akwutsɛ osunse mi ifu mgbangyilole bɛyi akwutsɛ itagwude; angwuto ondlɛndlɛ, angwuto omuma shinishini yi angwuto ovelevele yi angwuto omuma jaan; ali itɔ afutse ama ogbungbɛ bɛyi ali itɔ idabɔ ngwi a kyɔ mi ɛvɛ mnii duu yi ekwɔ ama ofyumfye mmya yi itigbla yi iyudza bɛyi ikwutsɛ osunse;

okye akwukwu mgbɛ, mgbi otse ogɛ iwu, engyie ofyunfyummya ogbungbɛ bɛyi ofufu otse otoola, eneekwɔ bɛyi engyie olivi, ofumbu osuse bɛyi alakama; mnda yi mmala; mmya yi ungwɔ ogbe okye sha ma; yi emi ofyɛɛ.
<<A ka gbɛɛ, <Ungwɔ osuse nmina abu otu duu ma lu dzɛ abu ta wa. Aludu bɛyi okwɔkwɔ mgbi abu duu byulu, o ka yɛ tu ma wuba.>
Ama okyummya ungwɔ ntonɛ nɛ, ntu aludu mbon ma ka kwudzɛ fyata, yi imio ewo mi isɔ mgban ogyeegye. A ka tsukwu di kyelela

content.text: angwuto omuma shinishini bɛyi omuma jaan,
dile kwɔ yi abashi, akwutsɛ osunse yi akwutsɛ
onikyɔ aludu mgbi ogalu nɛ bulu ngyɛ!>

content: <<Ali inggisɛ ama ofa iwudza eni, yi ama odzagaba mi iwudza eni duu, yi ama okyidɔ mi iwudza eni, yi ama okyummya nyɛ ongwi onikyekyoo duu, ka dzɛkɛ mbotunto mbyoo.
Ni a wa di iwu oduudu mgbi ogyola-gyola mgban ma, a ka gbobakwɔ gbɛɛ, <Ogalu oka teyi dzɛma dafi ongbodzi ogalu nɛ jo?>
A ka gbe abɔ dikye, le tsukwu di kyelela gbɛɛ:

content.text: imbe ngwi ama ndzɛ yi iwudza eni
yɛɛ emi awuya ikpewo aludu mgban!
Mi ongwonɔ gwee ta, o bulu waana!
Tsookwa won na, emi osaan yi ama
Imgbasho fwon ikwɔ mi ungwɔ ngwi
o kyɔ yi ema ma wa.> >>

content: Nɛ angbodzi ongyesɔ kyi kyelu ofishi nshe dafi onikwɔɔ okpinangwɔ mani kye ngwuta wokɛ ekyoo okwukwo, si gbɛɛ:

content.text: a ka kye angbodzi ogalu iBabyilon

content: A ka fwo ela ozuna bɛyi ungwɔ ogboogbo, yi oca ofoofo bɛyi agba ofoofo, mbi abu wuba.

content.text: ofufɛ bɛyi ongyaa ofufɛ mbi abu wuba.
abu nose ngha mi ɛsɛ duu.
O nu ɛsɛ duu boofɛ mi obudei mgbi abu.
A tu eyi mgbi ama ogbɛɛsɛ yi emi osaan,
